digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend adapter architecture and documentation
propositions: ADR 0035 contains four stale assertions that a second backend (GitHub adapter) would be the first real second backend, but Jira Data Center landed as a second backend first, making those statements false and requiring amendment across the file.

The TicketTransport protocol declares six members but the core reconciler accesses twenty-one distinct members on the transport, with twelve absent from the DC implementation and undeclared in any protocol, causing silent failures in production while all static and unit-level signals remain green.

RemoteRef.instance is presented as an existing deployment-distinction mechanism in ADR 0035, but it is never constructed in production code—only in test helpers—so the design is aspirational and the gap must be explicitly named and tracked.

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only when the port is complete and typed; an incomplete or unannotated transport parameter allows the port to pass static analysis while failing at runtime, which the ADR must state as a conditional claim.

The jira_family sub-seam architecture (two-level vendor-specific layer with parameterized contracts) and the shared jira provenance decision (one creation channel, instance-distinguished deployments) must be recorded in an amending ADR to prevent re-litigation when the next vendor adapter lands.

The documented configuration and dry-run commands in user-guide.md must be verified executable against a real Jira Data Center instance in CI rather than assumed to work, and the PAT credential must be enforced as environment-only to prevent accidental commit of secrets.
